WEEK 7  /  09G

for asset in assets:
    if not isinstance(asset, unreal.Texture2D):
        continue
    name = asset.get_name()
    compression = asset.get_editor_property(
        "compression_settings"
    )
    print(name, compression)
Continues the asset selection example. get_editor_property reads state. set_editor_property changes state. This example only reports.
Would changing this asset affect other materials?

02  Instructor demos
A small texture validation report
WEEK 7  /  09H
17
expected = unreal.TextureCompressionSettings.TC_NORMALMAP
for texture in assets:
    if not isinstance(texture, unreal.Texture2D):
        continue
    if texture.get_name().endswith("_N"):
        actual = texture.get_editor_property(
            "compression_settings")
        if actual != expected:
            print(texture.get_path_name(), actual, expected)
Illustrative naming rule: _N. Report every mismatch. The current Material/VFX tool does not repair shared texture settings.
What evidence would justify a repair?

02  Instructor demos
Component assignment and Undo
WEEK 7  /  09I
18
with unreal.ScopedEditorTransaction("Assign material"):
    component.modify()
    component.set_material(slot, instance)
    actual = component.get_material(slot)
    if actual != instance:
        raise RuntimeError("Assignment verification failed")
Validated component, slot and instance. One component override changes. Undo restores the assignment. The new instance asset remains.
Which change does this transaction cover?
